CONSTITUTION (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1981
CONSTITUTION (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1981
PRESIDENT S ORDER 14 OF 1981
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 25th November, 1981]
No. F.
l7(2)/81 Pub.
The following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977(C.M.L.A. Order
No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the
President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title
and commencement.-
(1) This Order may be called the Constitution (Fifth
Amendment) Order, 1981.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment
of Article 1 of P.O. No. 13 of 1981.-
In the Constitution (Fourth Amendment) Order, 1981
(P. O. No. 13 of 1981), in Article 1, in clause (2), after the word once at
the end, the words, comma and figure and shall be deemed to have taken effect
on the first day of July, 1981 shall be added and shall be deemed always to
have been so added.
